title: Jordan vs Egypt: Which Should You Visit?
description: A data-backed comparison of Jordan and Egypt based on Reddit discussions, real costs, safety data, and traveler preferences. Petra vs pyramids, Wadi Rum vs Nile cruises.

categories.title: 🏛️ Ancient Wonders & Historical Sites
categories.summary: Petra vs the Pyramids — both are life-changing, but Petra is more intimate and easier to experience independently. Egypt's historical depth is unmatched: Luxor alone has more ancient monuments than most countries.
redditQuotes: Petra is hands down the most impressive place I've ever visited — steps off the trails and you can sit on a rock and not see another person in a 360-degree view.

categories.title: 🍽️ Food & Cuisine
categories.summary: Jordan excels with mezze culture — hummus, mansaf, and shawarma at 1–2 JOD. Egypt wins on value: koshari at 15–30 EGP and Cairo's rooftop café scene is world-class.

categories.title: 💰 Cost Comparison
categories.summary: Egypt is 40–60% cheaper than Jordan. Daily budget: Jordan $70–120, Egypt $35–75. The Jordan Pass ($70–100) bundles visa + Petra entry and is almost always worth it.

categories.title: 🚌 Getting Around
categories.summary: Jordan is a road-trip country — rent a car (25–35 JOD/day). Egypt uses Uber in Cairo (very cheap) plus domestic flights for Luxor/Aswan.

categories.title: 🛡️ Safety
categories.summary: Jordan is one of the safest countries in the region for tourists, especially solo female travelers. Egypt requires more vigilance — hire a guide at major sites to eliminate friction.
redditQuotes: I've been to Jordan and Egypt. Would not recommend Egypt as a solo female traveler. I loved Jordan.

categories.title: 🌡️ Best Time to Visit
categories.summary: October–April is the sweet spot for both. Egypt's peak is November–March (Luxor summer heat is brutal). Jordan's most beautiful season is spring (March–May) with wildflowers in Petra.

categories.title: 🏨 Where to Stay
categories.summary: Jordan: Wadi Rum Bedouin bubble camps are among the world's most unique overnight experiences. Egypt: excellent 4-star hotels for $40–80/night.

categories.title: 🌊 Beaches & Nature
categories.summary: Egypt dominates on beaches — Sharm, Hurghada, Dahab with world-class Red Sea diving. Jordan's Wadi Rum desert is unlike anything else on Earth.

categories.title: 🔀 Why Not Both?
categories.summary: The Jordan–Egypt circuit is one of the world's great two-week trips. A 15-minute Aqaba–Taba ferry connects them. Petra + Wadi Rum + Pyramids + Nile cruise in one trip.
